scope: Targeted background-vs-mark review; final follow-up narrowed to Crypto and GOG. No production changes.

items.name: Bitcoin
items.evidence: Bitcoin Core primary repository SVG contains orange circular field and white B as one logo asset.
items.decision: Collection layout selects orange full-disc with B independently optically sized as a collection-layout adaptation; not a claim that official branding mandates full bleed.

items.name: Reddit
items.evidence: Official definition explicitly includes Snoo head within OrangeRed conversation bubble. Actual official icon includes bubble tail.
items.decision: Retain complete bubble as foreground on white; do not erase tail by treating orange as generic disc backdrop.

items.name: Messenger
items.evidence: Official blue icon shown as complete speech bubble with white bolt; clear space applies around complete icon.
items.decision: Bubble is logo geometry, not background; retain complete bubble, not bolt-only full-blue disc.

items.name: Crypto
items.evidence: Official developer app bitmap actually viewed: blue gradient rounded-square carrier with complete white hexagonal lion mark. Earlier v4 audit records original project cyan-green as custom color variant.
items.recommendation: Prefer verified official blue color family over copying project cyan-green. Adapt app carrier to full circle and scale complete white hexagon+lion together; do not extract lion alone.
items.confidence: Official app identity and appearance confirmed; exact hidden blue background still requires recovery or official separate asset.

items.name: GOG
items.evidence: Official website apple-touch bitmap actually viewed: purple gog.com lettering on white; no intrinsic dark-square border.
items.recommendation: Current dark/purple square can be treated as carrier, not immutable mark geometry. Either fixed dark full-disc plus original lettering (collection adaptation, current exact color variant not proven official), or verified purple official lettering on white. Avoid inset square card.
items.confidence: Shape/carrier separation supported by official alternate presentation; current dark color variant not independently verified.
